owner_evidence.source: Alien Survivor project conversation, after Human Sprite Review delivery
owner_evidence.exact_statement: ok the human asset is good but the firing animation that connects to the human is bad. lock human in

preserve: body proportions, palette, scale and silhouette
current body sprite pixels and existing locomotion baseline
not_approved: complete player family or full asset pack
scope.preservation_is_not_quality_approval: Existing hit/death frames are retained to avoid regressions; no new claim that their animation coverage is complete or approved.

baseline.frame_set_hash_method: SHA-256 of sorted relative path + TAB + file SHA-256 + LF for all 43 frames; paths are relative to the project root

constraints: Do not regenerate, repaint, recolour or rescale the human to hide a weapon alignment defect.
Keep the character ground pivot and feet stable; no whole-body recoil slide.
Bind the flash origin to the visible weapon muzzle using the same facing/scale/position as the human.
Check shooting while standing, walking and changing direction, including recoil and hit states.
Keep free gameplay aim unchanged; do not quantize damage or targeting to conceal four-view art limits.
Further body or locomotion edits require a new explicit owner decision.

publication.record: This file freezes the exact conversation-delivered HumanReview baseline; it does not claim its PNGs have been uploaded into every repository branch.
publication.alternate_procedural_models: Not promoted by this approval. Do not select an older robot or another human model because it fills more planned frame slots.
